verdict.rationale: Qualcomm's own developer stack (AI Engine Direct SDK, AI Hub, GenieX runtime) explicitly targets the Hexagon NPU/GPU/CPU and documents conversion to ONNX Runtime and LiteRT, and the developer portal frames this as covering 'Snapdragon X-series PCs.' However, none of the evidence explicitly confirms llama.cpp or MLX support, and the X2 Elite Extreme itself is unreleased (2026 ship date) so no hands-on runtime compatibility has been demonstrated yet. Missing for 10: explicit llama.cpp/MLX support statements, and independent confirmation that the new X2 Elite Extreme chip specifically (not just prior X-series) is supported by these runtimes.
